feature: Inline deletion and replacement corrections in translation answers
behavior: Required reference-difference corrections appear in the left answer as deleted original text followed by the corrected expression.
Correct, acceptable and optional wording remains unchanged; no extra links or locating actions.
Supports standard numbered and legacy three-column difference tables, explicit replacement suggestions and abbreviated legacy phrases.
Original submitted answers and stored learning data remain unchanged; rendering calls no model.
Adopting a changed verdict removes the corresponding annotation, and undo restores it.
